Refresh the local cache from the live biocOnIce catalog

Source: R/cache.R
ice_cache_refresh.Rd

Pulls hs_gene(), hs_alias(), hs_go(), hs_pubmed() in full (collect()), writes them as tables in a local DuckDB file managed by BiocFileCache, replacing any existing cache. This is the only function in this package that writes to the cache – call it again whenever you want a fresher local copy; nothing refreshes it automatically, and nothing calls it for you.

Usage

ice_cache_refresh(con = ice_con(), skip_alias = FALSE)

Arguments

con

a DBI connection to the live catalog; defaults to ice_con().

skip_alias

if TRUE, don't pull/cache the alias table – it dominates refresh time and isn't needed for gene/GO/pubmed lookups.

Value

The local cache file path (invisibly).

Details

Provisional: does not yet tag the cache with a bioc-on-ice provenance.release identifier (PlanFor3.24.md Milestone 8).

The new cache is built in a temporary file and only swapped in once every table has been pulled and written successfully. If the refresh is interrupted or errors partway through, the previous cache (if any) is left exactly as it was – ice_cache_exists() cannot report a half-written cache, and no temporary file is left behind.

alias (hs_alias()/identifier_mapping) is by far the largest of the four tables – on a real refresh it was ~6.6M rows and ~740s, versus well under two minutes combined for the other three. Set skip_alias = TRUE to leave it out of the refresh if you don't need cross-reference lookups; hs_alias(cache = TRUE) then errors telling you to refresh without skipping it.

Examples

old <- getOption("org.Hs.eg.ice.cache_dir")
options(org.Hs.eg.ice.cache_dir = tempfile())
ice_cache_refresh(skip_alias = TRUE)
#> duckdb keeps downloaded extensions and secrets in a temporary directory:
#> ℹ /tmp/RtmphLoDuZ/duckdb
#> This is removed when the R session ends.
#> • Extensions are re-downloaded each session.
#> • Secrets are lost.
#> ℹ Run duckdb(shared_home = TRUE) (or create ~/.duckdb) to keep them (suitable for most users).
#> ℹ Run duckdb(shared_home = FALSE) to accept the temporary directory (and silence this message).
#> ℹ See ?duckdb_storage for details and alternatives.
#> org.Hs.eg.ice: pulling gene ...
#> org.Hs.eg.ice: gene -- 193813 rows in 2.4s
#> org.Hs.eg.ice: pulling go ...
#> org.Hs.eg.ice: go -- 446674 rows in 4.1s
#> org.Hs.eg.ice: pulling pubmed ...
#> org.Hs.eg.ice: pubmed -- 3326577 rows in 6.2s
#> org.Hs.eg.ice: writing gene to local cache ...
#> org.Hs.eg.ice: writing go to local cache ...
#> org.Hs.eg.ice: writing pubmed to local cache ...
#> org.Hs.eg.ice: local cache refreshed at /tmp/RtmphLoDuZ/file2301d537fdb/23016fd2853f_23016fd2853fduckdb
ice_cache_exists()
#> [1] TRUE
hs_gene(cache = TRUE) |> dplyr::filter(symbol == "TP53") |> dplyr::collect()
#> duckdb keeps downloaded extensions and secrets in a temporary directory:
#> ℹ /tmp/RtmphLoDuZ/duckdb
#> This is removed when the R session ends.
#> • Extensions are re-downloaded each session.
#> • Secrets are lost.
#> ℹ Run duckdb(shared_home = TRUE) (or create ~/.duckdb) to keep them (suitable for most users).
#> ℹ Run duckdb(shared_home = FALSE) to accept the temporary directory (and silence this message).
#> ℹ See ?duckdb_storage for details and alternatives.
#> # A tibble: 1 × 9
#>   gene_id taxon_id symbol description       gene_type    chromosome map_location
#>   <chr>      <int> <chr>  <chr>             <chr>        <chr>      <chr>       
#> 1 7157        9606 TP53   tumor protein p53 protein-cod… 17         17p13.1     
#> # ℹ 2 more variables: valid_from <chr>, valid_to <chr>
ice_cache_clear()
options(org.Hs.eg.ice.cache_dir = old)
